source.title: Decouple RDC browser heartbeat from long normal-Chrome discovery pass
source.objective: The normal-Chrome bridge can spend minutes in initial discovery before heartbeat, producing a false browser-health unhealthy state despite active CDP. No exact active item covers heartbeat timing; create scoped work. No verified priority or dependency change.
